## Featured projects (personal, open source on GitHub)

All repositories are under https://github.com/sanketc001/.

### minimal-agent-harness: Minimal Agent Harness (Python)

https://github.com/sanketc001/minimal-agent-harness

Framework-free LLM agent harness in plain Python: tool-calling loop, raw Chrome DevTools Protocol browser, markdown memory vault, sub-agents and MCP server loading.

- Problem: See and control every step of an LLM agent, with no framework between the model and its tools.
- Built: A plain-Python harness with its own tool-calling loop, a browser driven over the raw Chrome DevTools Protocol, a markdown memory vault, sub-agents and MCP server loading.
- Stack: Python, LLM tool calling, Chrome DevTools Protocol, MCP
- Topics: llm-agents, tool-calling, mcp, cdp

### parsedin (TypeScript)

https://github.com/sanketc001/parsedin

Local-first knowledge graph of a professional network built from a LinkedIn data export, with LLM company resolution grounded in web evidence, an inbox with reply drafts and natural-language search.

- Problem: A LinkedIn data export is a folder of CSVs: it does not show who you know, where they work now, or who is waiting on a reply.
- Built: A local-first knowledge graph built from the export, with LLM company resolution grounded in web evidence, an inbox with reply drafts and natural-language search.
- Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, LLM entity resolution, Knowledge graph
- Topics: knowledge-graph, llm, local-first, nextjs

### ai-microdrama-studio: AI Microdrama Studio (Python)

https://github.com/sanketc001/ai-microdrama-studio

Local AI studio: an LLM director plans scenes; ComfyUI renders stills (Z-Image), edits (Flux.2 Klein) and video with synced audio (LTX-Video) plus OmniVoice TTS, behind a FastAPI job queue built for an 8 GB GPU.

- Problem: Turn a one-line premise into a short drama with consistent characters, voices and video, on a single 8 GB consumer GPU.
- Built: An LLM director that plans scenes, ComfyUI workflows for stills (Z-Image), edits (Flux.2 Klein) and video with synced audio (LTX-Video), OmniVoice TTS, all behind a FastAPI job queue.
- Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, ComfyUI, LTX-Video, Flux.2 Klein, OmniVoice
- Topics: comfyui, text-to-video, llm-director, tts

### prompt2ref (Python)

https://github.com/sanketc001/prompt2ref

Prompt → per-entity reference images (typed shots per person/landmark/vehicle) → ComfyUI video (MiniMax H3 Ref2VA) and image models (Qwen-Image-Edit, Flux.2 Klein).

- Problem: Reference-driven video and image models need good reference shots for every person, landmark and vehicle named in a prompt.
- Built: A pipeline that extracts entities from a prompt, collects typed reference shots for each, and feeds them to ComfyUI video (MiniMax H3 Ref2VA) and image models (Qwen-Image-Edit, Flux.2 Klein).
- Stack: Python, ComfyUI, MiniMax H3 Ref2VA, Qwen-Image-Edit, Flux.2 Klein
- Topics: comfyui, reference-images, video-generation

### Saathi-MCP-Family-Assistant: Saathi MCP Family Assistant (Python)

https://github.com/sanketc001/Saathi-MCP-Family-Assistant

MCP server exposing ~50 tools for household data, calendars, email, nutrition and finance to any MCP client.

- Problem: Household data such as calendars, email, meals and money lives in separate apps an assistant cannot reach.
- Built: An MCP server exposing about 50 tools over that data, usable from any MCP client.
- Stack: Python, MCP
- Topics: mcp, assistant, tools

### shorts-content-pipeline: Shorts Content Pipeline

https://github.com/sanketc001/shorts-content-pipeline

LLM scripts, ComfyUI text-to-image and image-to-image, and publishing to YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn from one FastAPI + React studio.

- Problem: Short-form content for several platforms means juggling separate tools for scripts, images and publishing.
- Built: One studio that writes scripts with an LLM, generates and edits images through ComfyUI, and publishes to YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn.
- Stack: FastAPI, React, LLMs, ComfyUI
- Topics: content-pipeline, comfyui, llm

### ai-timelines: AI Timelines

https://github.com/sanketc001/ai-timelines

Research agent that searches, reads pages with Playwright and files sources into a browsable timeline and graph (Azure OpenAI tool calling).

- Problem: Researching a topic leaves dozens of tabs and no record of how the sources relate over time.
- Built: A research agent that searches, reads pages with Playwright and files each source into a browsable timeline and graph, using Azure OpenAI tool calling.
- Stack: Azure OpenAI, Tool calling, Playwright
- Topics: research-agent, tool-calling, playwright
